summary: cicd.writeVersionPins(repo:, pins:, message:) lands in JenkinsPipelineUtils/vars/cicd.groovy (482706a on phase/011-P2): it clones a deploy repo, rewrites the named YAML paths in the named values files surgically, and commits and pushes the whole set as one commit, erroring on a path the file does not already hold and committing nothing when nothing changed. The repo has no gate and this environment has no JVM (Ruling 2), so in its place I ran a line-for-line Python transcription of the rewrite (40 checks against P1's real stage files), a clone-edit-commit-push rehearsal against a local bare remote, sh -n on both emitted shell scripts and a delimiter check over the file - all green, and the transcription caught one real bug before commit.
